name: Wallet 3
definition: Container for tenders used by the customer to perform the payment transaction.

Provider.name: Provider
Provider.definition: Identification of the provider of the wallet.

PANAge.name: PAN Age
PANAge.definition: Number of days that the user’s PAN has been on file for the user.

UserAccountAge.name: User Account Age
UserAccountAge.definition: Number of days since the user wallet account for this user exists.

AccountAge.name: Account Age
AccountAge.definition: Number of days since the user created the wallet account or started using the wallet.

DaysSinceLastActivity.name: Days Since Last Activity
DaysSinceLastActivity.definition: Number of days since the last activity on the wallet.

Activity.name: Activity
Activity.definition: Number of transactions on this wallet within an interval.

ActivityInterval.name: Activity Interval
ActivityInterval.definition: Identifies the interval of the activity.

LastWalletChange.name: Last Wallet Change
LastWalletChange.definition: Number of days since wallet settings were changed.

SuspendedCards.name: Suspended Cards
SuspendedCards.definition: Number of cards suspended in the wallet.

CardDataEntryMode.name: Card Data Entry Mode
CardDataEntryMode.definition: Method used to capture the card details for the wallet.

OtherCardDataEntryMode.name: Other Card Data Entry Mode
OtherCardDataEntryMode.definition: Other method used to capture the card details.

AccountEmailAge.name: Account Email Age
AccountEmailAge.definition: Number of days the email address has been in the wallet.

ProviderRiskAssessmentModelVersion.name: Provider Risk Assessment Model Version
ProviderRiskAssessmentModelVersion.definition: Wallet Provider Risk Assessment Model Version used to create scores.

ProviderPhoneScore.name: Provider Phone Score
ProviderPhoneScore.definition: A value to determine trust level of the phone number.

ProviderDeviceScore.name: Provider Device Score
ProviderDeviceScore.definition: A value to determine trust level of the device.

ProviderAccountScore.name: Provider Account Score
ProviderAccountScore.definition: A value to determine trust level of the account.
